title: Quantum Ancilla Optimizer
blurb: Compiles arbitrary boolean expressions into Grover oracles by walking the AST. Then, solves the Reversible Pebble Game using the Z3 Solver to minimizes ancilla qubit count.

title: herd
blurb: Routes coding subagents across Claude, Codex and Cursor by tier and live quota, each in its own git worktree. A rate-limited task fails over to another provider in the same worktree.

title: Midboss Mayhem
blurb: A round-based 6v6 Deadlock mode fought in the midboss pit, built as a Deadworks plugin around a phase machine, with self-test suites and a Loadout Builder for hero builds.

title: Valorant Assistant
blurb: Positioning advice from safe zones mapped over 10K ranked matches. A Redis hot-path cache in front of MongoDB holds p95 latency under 100 ms over 1.1M match points.
